one_liner: Punctual German-raised pastry-shop daughter who lives by the schedule down to the second.
personality: Eishin Flash is earnest, polite and meticulous: she plans meals, rest and even 'thinking about family' to the minute, and her lines are full of schedules, plans and precise timings. She is proud of her parents' German cake shop and treats racing like patisserie craft, aiming to become a 'Meister'. Warm under the formality, she thanks the trainer for showing her viewpoints she lacks, asks to be told when her clumsiness shows, and gets flustered by the unexpected.

story_arc.summary: Raised in Germany who believes her perfect schedules are the road to victory, Flash must learn to cope with what falls outside the plan; her career event titles are German phrases (Die Frage, Leichter gesagt als getan., Das Versprechen) and a home line thanks the trainer for showing her why she guards her schedule so strictly (voice 10000). The real horse won the 2010 Japanese Derby and the 2012 Tenno Sho (Autumn) (general knowledge, unverified in mdb); her goals per event titles include the Keisei Hai, Satsuki Sho, Derby, Japan Cup, Arima Kinen, Osaka Hai and both Tenno Sho.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Eishin_Flash; model knowledge (unverified) for real-horse results
